preamble: Lateralization of the alveolar sibilant [s] to the voiceless lateral fricative [ɬ]. The best-known case is Taishanese and other Siyi Yue varieties, where Middle Chinese *s- became [ɬ] (三 'three' MC sam > Taishanese ɬam³³, Cantonese saam1). Many Yue varieties of Guangxi and western Guangdong also have [ɬ].
